messages:
eli: Heads up  we need a quick decision on April milestone scope. Two realistic options: narrow MVP surface or slip freeze by 6 days.
zoe: list the candidate items to cut or defer?
mike: from the spec: A) tenant model pinning UI (polish), B) live embedding cache dashboard, C) admin bulk CSV import/export, D) lightweight latency probe hook.
tara: customers asked for C, but we can make it async to reduce risk. A and B feel v1 to me. D is tiny and useful.
eli: proposal: MVP = async admin import/export (beta flagged for pilot tenants) + latency probe. Defer A & B to v1. Add a 6-day freeze buffer to be safe.
zoe: operational ask: if we keep C in MVP, we must enforce RBAC + audit + S3 expiry. Can devs meet that within the current window?
mike: dev estimates: async C + probe = 6 dev-days, QA ~2 days. With current infra constraints week-of-April-6 we should add the 6-day freeze.
tara: agree. Whitelist + feature-flag reduces blast radius. I'll draft the RBAC acceptance checklist.
qa-bot: QA ticket QA-4700 opened: smoke, export integrity, RBAC regression, audit logs.
eli: @release-bot please add +6d freeze and 3-stage canary (5% -> 30% -> 100%) and set emergency fallback to prev-stable.
release-bot: milestone "2026-04-release" updated: freeze +6 days, canary 5%->30%->100%, fallback to stable-2026-03. :white_check_mark:
zoe: action items: @tara spec RBAC + whitelist today; @mike add feature-flag and async job; @eli update customer comms; @qa-bot run acceptance. Reconvene 11:00 PT.
eli: final call? if no objections by EOD we ship MVP as proposed.
mike: +1.
tara: +1.
zoe: +1.
eli: cool, locking this unless someone raises a blocker. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
